system.description:
When you are in the [Dual Wielding] state and [Hate Under], add +2D to the damage roll of [Melee Attack] with this weapon. A sword that seems to have been forged from shadow itself, its surface as smooth and unblemished as pitch-black night. When wielded as a pair of blades, it can cast illusions that confuse the senses. Should an enemy even slightly divert their attention from its edge, they will be struck down by a fatal blow.

[Core Material](100G)+ (160G)×2+[ 7](60G)×2+Crafting Cost(250G)
